answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity: each agent locks a refundable deposit before bidding or voting. Every identity costs real stake, so a sybil attacker flooding the network with shills faces a huge upfront bill; each sock puppet must fund its own bond. Peer validators flag dishonest agents, who lose the deposit through slashing, so each fake bleeds capital. The deposit acts as a beacon of commitment: honest agents keep stake while a sybil farm drowning in an ocean of duplicates loses money. Verifiable compute adds another pigment, each identity spends scarce compute to authenticate.
